identity: One original Reedbarge Pole human barge guard, facing screen right in an elevated orthographic three-quarter camera. Exactly two arms and two booted legs. Weathered straw conical hat with a few reeds, short brown beard, teal neck scarf and tunic, straw shoulder cape, beige patched coat, rope coil at belt, brown wrapped leather boots. One long rigid brown wooden dock pole with a single curved iron hook and hanging reed tassel at its upper/front end. The near hand on screen left grips the lower/rear shaft; the far hand on screen right grips the upper/front shaft. Both original hands retain their proper grip; never exchange ends of the pole. Preserve the head, hat, straw cape, long shaft, single hook, tassel and clothing.
acceptance: 137 selected original video frames across six actions; retained eight reviewed articulated idle poses and pixel-identical overworld idle. All source frames reviewed chronologically, enlarged edges/equipment and native Godot phases inspected. 218 candidate and 232 live focused Windows checks passed. No continuous playback or manual playtest claimed.
